help.title: Help
help.subtitle: How to try Legatio in a few steps

steps.title: Create an agent
steps.body: Go to Agents → New agent. Give it a name (e.g. “Travel assistant”).

steps.title: Define a constitution
steps.body: Constitutions → New. Attach it to your agent and (via seed or later rules) define limits like max price.

steps.title: Start a negotiation
steps.body: Negotiations → New. Pick your agent, an external agent, and the constitution. Then Start and Process round.

steps.title: Approve if asked
steps.body: If policy requires human approval, open Approvals and approve or reject.

steps.title: Review agreement & audit
steps.body: Signed outcomes appear under Agreements. Every step is logged in Audit.

faqs.a: A control layer between humans and autonomous AI agents: rules (constitutions), negotiations, human approvals, signed agreements and an audit trail.

faqs.q: Do I need real external APIs?
faqs.a: No. The MVP uses simulated external agents from the seed so you can demo the full flow offline.

faqs.q: Why is the agent list empty?
faqs.a: Create your own agent under Agents, or run ./scripts/seed.sh so demo agents exist.
Advances one negotiation round: the simulated counterparty proposes, policies evaluate, and you may get ALLOW, DENY, or REQUIRE_HUMAN_APPROVAL.
Optional. Enable it under Profile. After that, login asks for a TOTP code.

home.headline: Humans stay in control when agents negotiate
home.lead: Legatio lets you define rules, run multi-round negotiations, require human approval when risk is high, and keep a verifiable audit trail.

pillars.title: Constitutions
pillars.body: Policy rules your agents must obey: budgets, privacy, auto-renewal limits.

pillars.title: Negotiations
pillars.body: Structured rounds between your agent and external parties with clear outcomes.

pillars.title: Human-in-the-loop
pillars.body: High-risk proposals pause for approval. Agreements and audit close the loop.

flow.title: Agent
flow.body: Create the agent that acts on your behalf.

flow.title: Rules
flow.body: Attach a constitution with enforceable limits.

flow.title: Negotiate
flow.body: Run rounds until accept, deny, or approval.

flow.title: Record
flow.body: Sign agreements and inspect the audit chain.

home.bottomTitle: Built for demos and real control
home.bottomBody: Start with seed data or create your own agent in seconds. English and Spanish UI, light and dark themes.
